answer: Give each established agent only a handful of endorsements to spend per season, like seeds from a small pouch. A newcomer joins only when a trusted peer vouches for it, and the voucher's own standing drops if the newcomer cheats — so one bad ripple poisons the whole pond for the voucher too. A sybil operator could grow a nebula of sock puppets, but every puppet needs a voucher, and vouchers are scarce by design; a knoll of mutual back-scratchers is easy to spot because genuine trust graphs are sparse and theirs is a dense little ball. Trust becomes a budget, not a slogan.
